title: Dummy
scene: Bristol trip-hop; hip-hop breaks and cinematic torch song
notes: Wounded torch songs over bespoke sampled breaks, noir guitars and stark silences.

title: Portishead
scene: Bristol trip-hop; orchestral noir and original-source sampling
notes: Home-built samples and phased vocals deepen the noir into claustrophobic orchestrated torch songs.

title: Roseland NYC Live
scene: Bristol trip-hop performed with orchestral ensemble in New York
notes: A 35-piece orchestra recasts fragile trip-hop as tense, dramatic live arrangements.

title: Third
scene: British experimental electronic rock; krautrock and industrial rhythms
notes: Taut motorik repetition, hostile drum machines and haunted analogue textures replace the earlier sample-noir.
